concerns.text: FR-001 mandates data from 'the HCP 1200 Subjects Release (Music Task subset)', but T001 fetches OpenNeuro ds000233 exclusively. The tasks document silently relaxes a MUST-level FR with no spec amendment; the 'Data source decision' preamble cites plan feasibility but the spec FR text still names HCP. Either amend FR-001 (and the HCP-scoped Principle VI preamble) or the task weakens the requirement.

FR-002 and Principle VI require fMRIPrep (CPU-only) preprocessing. T002's CI-tractable path substitutes a nilearn pipeline (motion correction + bandpass), so the preprocessing actually executed and validated in the research stage is not fMRIPrep. The off-CI fMRIPrep wrapper exists but no task verifies it runs or produces output. The task should explicitly state the CI path is a logic-validation surrogate and that only the off-CI fMRIPrep run satisfies FR-002, with a verification step for the wrapper itself.

Plan Task 3.4 (bootstrap stability, 1000 iterations, full dataset) is an implementation-phase deliverable, but T012 defers it entirely to the 'paper pipeline' handoff with no research-stage task producing the stability artifact. This is retroactive narrowing of a plan deliverable; either add a task or make the deferral an explicit, spec-sanctioned staging decision.

Plan Task 4.2 requires 'network diagrams' as a visualization deliverable; T009 produces only scatters and a bar chart. The network-diagram output has no implementing task and no documented drop rationale.

FR-004 and US-2 require edge-level connectivity strengths as predictors, and T004 computes them, but T005 (merge) and T008 (regression) describe only scalar network metrics. Whether edge features enter the partial correlations/regression (or are excluded after VIF/PCA) is unstated — the FR's downstream use is silently narrowed.
